e.title: Netspar（荷兰养老金、老龄化与退休研究网络）：知识中心与项目组
e.title_en: Netspar (Network for Studies on Pensions, Aging and Retirement): a knowledge hub and project groups
e.title_hk: Netspar（荷蘭養老金、老齡化與退休研究網絡）：知識中心與項目組
e.summary: 荷兰产学研养老金研究网络：知识中心（出版物）、在研与已完成研究、按主题的项目组，另有面向研究者的入口与例会日程
e.summary_en: The Dutch industry-academia pension research network: a knowledge hub of publications, ongoing and completed research, theme-based project groups, a researchers’ entry point and a meeting calendar
e.summary_hk: 荷蘭產學研養老金研究網絡：知識中心（出版物）、在研與已完成研究、按主題的項目組，另有面向研究者的入口與例會日程
e.body:
**Netspar（Network for Studies on Pensions, Aging and Retirement）** 是**荷兰的养老金研究网络**——由**学界与养老金行业（基金、保险公司、监管与政策部门）共同参与**，属**「产学研网络」**形态。本条与 [[cepar]]、[[nber]] 同属本轮**新形态**（研究机构/网络），实测池内 **Netspar 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **306.8KB**；⭐ **知识中心（Publications）`/en/knowledge-hub/`（294.5KB）**；**在研与已完成研究 `/en/research/`（211.8KB）**；⭐ **项目组 `/en/project-groups/`（176.6KB）**；另有 **For Researchers（面向研究者）** 入口与**按主题组织的页面**（实测含 **well-being and welfare of older people**、**communication and choice**、**work, retirement, housing and healthcare**）；**日程**实测含 **2026-09-24 在鹿特丹的项目组例会**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「产学研网络」这一形态**——它的独特之处是**成果由学界与业界共同生产**：项目组（project groups）把**研究者、养老金基金与保险公司的人放在同一议题下**，因此其**出版物往往比纯学术论文更贴近制度与实务**；对做**荷兰养老金改革（DB→DC）**、**行为金融与退休选择**、**养老金沟通**类题目的学生，这是**比期刊更容易进入的入口**（可与 [[dnb]] 的荷兰覆盖率统计、[[pensionsmyndigheten]] 的瑞典模型并读，形成**「荷兰：监管统计 + 产学研研究」「瑞典：机构统计 + 公开模型」**的对照）。**② 与 [[cepar]]（学术中心）、[[nber]]（经济学工作论文）构成研究来源的三层**——**网络（Netspar）／中心（CEPAR）／国家局（NBER）**，三者在**「谁生产研究、面向谁、以什么形式发布」**上各不相同；**③ 主题分类**（老年福祉、沟通与选择、工作/退休/住房与医疗）本身就是**养老金研究议程的现成地图**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、知识中心、研究页、项目组页与主题/日程链接的存在及页面体量**，**但未打开任何出版物**，因此**不能确认其出版物的评审方式、语言与开放获取状态**；**②** 站点以**荷兰语/英语双语**呈现，**英文覆盖度未逐项核实**；**③** 项目组与例会的**参与门槛（是否需会员）未核实**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供数据或软件。**核实说明**：首页（306.8KB）、`/en/knowledge-hub/`（294.5KB）、`/en/research/`（211.8KB）、`/en/project-groups/`（176.6KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未打开任何出版物、未核实会员门槛**。
e.body_en:
**Netspar (Network for Studies on Pensions, Aging and Retirement)** is **the Dutch pension research network**, involving **academia together with the pension industry** (funds, insurers, supervisors and policy bodies) — an "**industry–academia network**" form. With [[cepar]] and [[nber]], it belongs to this round’s **new form** (research institutions and networks); **Netspar-related entries measured zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **306.8KB**; ⭐ the **knowledge hub (publications) `/en/knowledge-hub/` (294.5KB)**; **ongoing and completed research `/en/research/` (211.8KB)**; ⭐ **project groups `/en/project-groups/` (176.6KB)**; plus a **For Researchers** entry and **theme-based pages** (measured to include **well-being and welfare of older people**, **communication and choice**, and **work, retirement, housing and healthcare**); the **calendar** shows a **project group meeting in Rotterdam on 2026-09-24**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "industry–academia network" form** — its distinctive feature is that **output is co-produced by academia and industry**: **project groups bring researchers together with people from pension funds and insurers around a single topic**, so their **publications tend to sit closer to institutions and practice than pure journal articles**; for students working on **Dutch pension reform (DB to DC)**, **behavioural finance and retirement choice**, or **pension communication**, this is **an easier entry point than journals** (readable alongside [[dnb]]’s Dutch funding-ratio statistics and [[pensionsmyndigheten]]’s Swedish model, giving a **"Netherlands: supervisory statistics plus network research" versus "Sweden: agency statistics plus a published model"** contrast). **② With [[cepar]] (a research centre) and [[nber]] (an economics working-paper series) it forms three layers of research source** — **network / centre / national bureau** — differing in **who produces the research, for whom, and in what form**; **③ its theme taxonomy** (older people’s welfare, communication and choice, work/retirement/housing/healthcare) is itself **a ready map of the pension research agenda**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence and page sizes of the homepage, knowledge hub, research page, project groups page and the theme/calendar links**, **but opened no publication**, so **their review process, language and open-access status cannot be confirmed**; **② the site presents Dutch and English**, and **English coverage was not verified item by item**; **③** the **participation threshold for project groups and meetings (whether membership is required) was not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site provides data or software**. **Verification note**: the homepage (306.8KB), `/en/knowledge-hub/` (294.5KB), `/en/research/` (211.8KB) and `/en/project-groups/` (176.6KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no publication was opened and no membership threshold was verified**.
e.body_hk:
**Netspar（Network for Studies on Pensions, Aging and Retirement）** 是**荷蘭的養老金研究網絡**，由**學界與養老金行業共同參與**，屬**「產學研網絡」**形態。本條與 [[cepar]]、[[nber]] 同屬本輪**新形態**；實測池內 **Netspar 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **306.8KB**；⭐ **知識中心（出版物）294.5KB**；**在研與已完成研究 211.8KB**；⭐ **項目組 176.6KB**；另有 **For Researchers** 入口與**按主題的頁面**（老年福祉、溝通與選擇、工作/退休/住房與醫療）；**日程**實測含 **2026-09-24 鹿特丹項目組例會**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「產學研網絡」這一形態**——**項目組把研究者與養老金基金／保險公司的人放在同一議題下**，故其**出版物往往比純學術論文更貼近制度與實務**；對做**荷蘭 DB→DC 改革、行為金融與退休選擇、養老金溝通**類題目的學生，這是**比期刊更容易進入的入口**（可與 [[dnb]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]] 形成對照）；**② 與 [[cepar]]、[[nber]] 構成研究來源三層**（**網絡／中心／國家局**）；**③ 主題分類**本身是**養老金研究議程的現成地圖**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**五類頁面的存在與體量**，**但未打開任何出版物**；**② 英文覆蓋度未逐項核實**；**③** 項目組與例會的**參與門檻未核實**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供數據或軟件。**核實說明**：四頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何出版物**。
